UK annual CPI inflation rose to 3.1% in August from 2.9% in July, matching market expectations and reaching its highest level in five months.

Transport costs were the biggest driver, with transport inflation rising to 4.6% from 3.6% as motor fuel inflation jumped to 23% from 15.5%. Petrol and diesel prices rose to 161.3 pence and 181.8 pence per liter, respectively.
Core CPI inflation held at 2.6%. Goods inflation rose to 2.7% from 2.2%, while services inflation was unchanged at 3.4%.

title: UK inflation rises to 3.1% in August, driven by higher fuel costs
